title: Fix Menu System to Match Original Behavior
instructions:
Restore the auto-generative menu system to function exactly as it did before. The menus should:
1. Auto-generate from directory structure in ~/.config/KosDWM/Menus/
2. Support Python scripts that run commands (like lsof in background)
3. Support leaf menus with config.json that open content windows
4. Preserve all original functionality including script execution

1784844999.8897955.instruction:
Examine the existing menu directory structure at ~/.config/KosDWM/Menus/ to understand:
- What folders exist and their hierarchy
- What config.json files contain
- What Python scripts exist and what they do
- How the original menu system was supposed to work
Document the findings for reference.

1784845002.7527075.instruction:
Fix menus_pyqt5.py to properly scan the ~/.config/KosDWM/Menus/ directory structure:
- Each folder = menu/submenu item
- Folders with config.json = leaf menus that open content windows
- .py files in folders = runnable scripts
- Nested folders = nested submenus
- Must preserve exact original behavior

1784845005.624539.instruction:
Ensure Python scripts in menu folders execute properly:
- Scripts like ok.py should run when clicked
- Scripts should run commands (lsof, etc.) in background
- Use subprocess.Popen with proper arguments
- Handle script output/errors gracefully
- Scripts should not block the UI

1784845008.2822905.instruction:
Restore leaf menu functionality for folders with config.json:
- Read config.json for window title and content file
- Display content from referenced file (txt, html, etc.)
- Apply light theme styling to content window
- Support refresh button for dynamic content
- Handle missing files gracefully with helpful message

1784845011.3546872.instruction:
Test all menu functionality end-to-end:
- Click ☰ to open menu
- Navigate Home → About (should open content window)
- Navigate Home → Test (should run Python script)
- Verify scripts run commands in background
- Verify all menus have light theme
- Document any issues found
